review_scope: Source-code/schema review of aggregation and token-binding reproducer; no native answer content inspected, no model calls, no aggregation executed before all grades.

provenance.reviewer: native collector author reviewing separately authored root aggregation
provenance.phase: Main fixed32-cell inference underway; output-limit failure metadata known, raw answers not read.

findings.finding: Mapping request identity lacked an explicit question/condition join.
findings.resolution: Root added request_id == question_id + double-underscore + condition before native response lookup.

findings.finding: Selected/executed input comparison did not explicitly compare rendered prompt hash.
findings.resolution: Root added rendered_prompt_sha256 equality in addition to token count and token-ID hash.

findings.finding: Aggregation lacked direct grading-packet/reference/contract and full-response/projection provenance checks.
findings.resolution: Root added packet SHA, immutable reference and scoring-contract SHA, raw response file SHA against native receipt and projection SHA against actual public projection.

confirmed_behavior.joint_definition: content AND scope AND citation; output-budget failure remains separate exactly as frozen v13 scoring contract specifies. No silent grade override.
confirmed_behavior.required_fact_ids: Uses fact_id from unchanged question references; enforces exact set and count per graded case.
confirmed_behavior.raw_answer_crosslinks: Case content hash, mapped content hash and actual native projection content hash must match.
confirmed_behavior.context_crosslinks: Case, mapping, retrieval and source-support hashes must match; token count/token-ID/rendered hash must match native prompt.
confirmed_behavior.prior_reader_contrasts: Exactly ordinary/paired against v13 layout records; source context hashes must match. Reader checkpoint/quantization/template/nonthinking changes remain joint factors.
confirmed_behavior.duplicate_groups: Groups all32 native inputs by exact token-ID hash; reports whether content hashes agree without dropping duplicate cases.
confirmed_behavior.semantic_disagreements: Joint-pass cases whose separate received-context review is incomplete are explicitly listed rather than silently reconciled.
confirmed_behavior.deterministic_replay: --check requires exact serialized summary replay from frozen artifacts; final execution pending.

reproducer_review.status: Corresponds to earlier inline full-request32-token comparison using same native render/tokenize/validate functions, but is not retroactively represented as the source that executed the earlier receipt.

remaining_validation: Run root aggregation only after all32 native responses and both16-case grading files exist.
Final portable/external audit must verify exact32-case joins, aggregate counts, same-context contrasts, duplicate groups and exposed support/grade disagreements.
Any semantic support/grade disagreement needs explicit review; this code review does not adjudicate answers.
